shortDescription: Download fixes for VIOS from EFD.

options.name: action
options.description: Specifies the action that the module needs to perform. C(list) Lists the fixes that are available for user's machine. C(download) Downloads a specific fix for machine.

options.name: clean_directory
options.description: Specifies if the directory should be emptied or not.

options.name: directory
options.description: Specifies the directory where the user wants the file to be downloaded.

options.name: fix_id
options.description: Specifies the file that the user wants to be downloaded.
